title: AVX-512 zmm bipedal-3 kernel for permanent_bipedal3
description:
Implement an AVX-512 (512-bit zmm, 8×u64 lanes) backend for the bipedal-3 `Config3` kernel in `gf2-kernels-simd::bipedal`, mirroring the existing AVX2 `Config3Avx2` path but doubling the SIMD width and unlocking ~2× lane throughput on AVX-512-capable hosts. Continuation of the bipedal-3 F_3 permanent SIMD work landed under epic `ae82bd73` (T12 `686ee1b5`, T13 SIMD dispatch wiring, S1 c98ed603 measurement).

## Background

The AVX2 path achieves a 10.643× speedup over `permanent_mod3_reference` at n=36 on the dev host (Ryzen 9 5900X, AVX2-only) — see `dev/plans/s1_speedup_results.md` and `dev/benchmarks/gf2_algebra_permanent/s1_speedup-2026-05-11.csv`. AVX-512 zmm doubles the packed lane count (4×u64 → 8×u64) and is the natural CPU-side continuation. The bipedal-3 `add_lane` / `sub_lane` formulas are pure bitwise and translate directly from `_mm256_*` to `_mm512_*` intrinsics.

This was originally scoped inside S3 (`363556e6`) and the user's direction on 2026-05-11 was "Defer AVX-512 to 7f809931. We can only do AVX2 at the moment." This issue is the concrete child of `7f809931` that the S3 amendment will point at.

## Hardware availability

The dev host has no AVX-512 hardware (Zen 3 5900X). Implementation work can compile + unit-test via QEMU or a remote AVX-512-capable host (Zen 4 / Ice Lake / Sapphire Rapids); throughput validation requires real hardware.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `gf2-kernels-simd::bipedal::Config3Avx512` (or equivalent) implements the same trait surface as `Config3Avx2`, using `__m512i` lanes with `_mm512_*` intrinsics for `pack`, `unpack`, `add_lane`, `sub_lane`, `neg_lane`.
- [ ] [hard] Runtime detection via `OnceLock<Option<BipedalAvx512Fns>>`, mirroring `detect_avx2`. `permanent_bipedal3_singleword` dispatcher selects AVX-512 → AVX-2 → scalar in that order.
- [ ] [hard] Bit-identical output against the AVX2 path on the project's existing bipedal3 cross-check suite (seeded LCG matrices at n ∈ {8, 16, 32, 48, 63}).
- [ ] [hard] Compile-gated behind `#[cfg(all(target_arch = "x86_64", target_feature = "avx512f"))]` plus `#[target_feature(enable = "avx512f,avx512bw,avx512vl")]` on the kernel functions; default workspace build still succeeds on AVX2-only hosts.
- [ ] [hard] MSRV 1.95 compatibility verified per `CLAUDE.md` "Breakdown-time feasibility check" — the specific `_mm512_*` intrinsics used must be stable on 1.95.
- [ ] [hard] Unit tests at the kernel level (parity vs scalar `Config3` on small inputs) compile and pass on AVX-512 hosts; on AVX2-only hosts they are gated out (no false-positive PASS via scalar fallback).
- [ ] [aspirational] AVX-512 throughput is ≥ 1.5× the AVX2 throughput on the same matrix at n ∈ {28, 32, 36} (this is the criterion that S3 deferred here).

## Out of scope

- HIP/ROCm GPU path — that's `ad55b777` and the GPU follow-up `9480f8a6`.
- AVX-512 IFMA prime-field batch (separate issue `b59fa661`).
- AVX-512 VPCLMULQDQ / GFNI for GF(2^m) (separate issue `c7c0e991`).
